description: A plain circular award badge sits above two broad ribbons that angle outward toward the bottom. Each ribbon ends in a forked notch, and their inner edges meet beneath the centre of the disc.
A circular award badge has a smaller concentric circle forming an inset rim. Two long ribbon tails descend from its lower edge and spread outward, each ending in a forked notch.
A plain circular award badge sits above two long ribbons that spread slightly toward the bottom. Each ribbon has a forked end, creating a narrow central opening beneath the disc.

A slender front-facing human statuette has a small oval head, broad shoulders, and arms held close against its torso. Its long straight lower body stands on a rectangular pedestal with a wider bottom edge.
A trophy has a deep rounded cup with a flat top and a curved loop handle on either side. A short flared stem connects the cup to a low rectangular pedestal.
A plain circular badge sits at the top of one broad vertical ribbon. The ribbon extends straight down from behind the disc and ends in a deep upward-pointing forked notch.

An awareness ribbon forms a tall loop with crossed descending tails at the centre of a butterfly silhouette. Matching wings curve outward on either side in broad upper lobes and smaller scalloped lower lobes.
A person sits in profile facing right above a large wheelchair wheel, with bent legs extending forward. One arm reaches outward to hold a tilted pole carrying a small waving flag.
A gift box has a broad overhanging lid and a tall body with rounded bottom corners. Two low teardrop-shaped bow loops spread outward from the centre of the lid, above a blank front panel.
A gift box has a wide overhanging lid and a nearly square body with rounded bottom corners. Two broad bow loops meet above the centre of the lid, while the front remains unmarked.
A gift box has a wide rounded lid above a box body with softened lower corners. Two curved bow loops rise from the lid’s centre and lean outward over the blank front.
A gift box has an overhanging rectangular lid, rounded lower corners, and two tall bow loops meeting at the top centre. A single vertical ribbon line runs through the lid and down the front.
A gift box has a wide rectangular lid and straight-sided body divided by a broad vertical ribbon. Two outward-leaning bow loops meet at a small central knot directly above the ribbon.
A square gift box has a broad overhanging lid and a vertical ribbon band running down its front. Two upright rounded bow loops converge at the centre of the lid.
A large circular emblem has an inset circular border and a blank horizontal banner across its lower portion. The banner extends beyond the circle on both sides, ending in folded forked tails.
A circular medal with a concentric inset ring hangs below a broad folded neck ribbon. The ribbon has angled outer shoulders, inward-sloping sides, and a horizontal band joining its upper portions.
A plain circular medal hangs from a short inverted triangular ribbon. The ribbon has a wide horizontal top and sloping sides that meet the upper edge of the round medallion.
A front-facing human statuette has a detached oval head, broad shoulders, and arms held against the torso. Its narrow legs stand on a curved-top pedestal above a wider rounded rectangular base.

Two hand-shaped clapper toys overlap above crossed long handles with rounded ends. Their splayed finger silhouettes face upward and outward, with short curved motion marks floating above the two hands.

Two raised open hands overlap diagonally, with one palm prominent in front and the second behind it to the right. Long upright fingers, outward thumbs, and three short marks above convey the clapping gesture.

A large four-point sparkle occupies the left side, accompanied by a smaller sparkle at the upper right and the smallest at the lower right. Each outlined sparkle has concave sides flowing into pointed tips.
A large outlined four-point sparkle sits to the left of a small cross-shaped glint and a tiny diamond-shaped glint. The main sparkle has deeply curved concave sides and long pointed tips.

A centred four-point sparkle has deeply concave sides joining its pointed tips. Eight detached straight rays surround it evenly, extending horizontally, vertically, and diagonally to form a balanced burst.

A large four-point sparkle occupies the left side, accompanied by a smaller sparkle at the upper right and the smallest at the lower right. Each outlined sparkle has concave sides flowing into pointed tips.

A front-facing chest has a rounded domed lid above a broad box body with curved lower corners. Two vertical reinforcing bands cross the lid and body, with a small central latch below the horizontal lid seam.
A crown has a tall central point flanked by two shorter outward points and deep angled valleys. Its sides taper toward a straight lower edge, with a separate horizontal band beneath the body.
A rounded royal crown has two broad outer lobes and a central arched panel above a low rounded band. A cross rises directly from the top centre as the crown’s attached finial.
A curved crown has a raised central lobe topped by an oval finial, with two outward-leaning side points. Its sloping sides join a curved elliptical band that gives the base depth.
A crown has one tall central point and two shorter outward-curving side points, separated by deep valleys. The sides taper toward a curved elliptical band forming the lower rim.
A rounded royal crown has broad outer lobes and a central arched panel above a low rounded band. A small circular orb sits on a short post at the top centre.
